title: Large-code-base feature assignment with GitHub Copilot
summary: Students add a Go to Definition feature to Python's 24,000-line idlelib code base after instruction on GitHub Copilot. They must use and document Copilot features, retain a process journal, and submit the complete chat transcript as process evidence.

sources.title: Students' Use of GitHub Copilot for Working with Large Code Bases
sources.evidence_quote: add a 'Go to Definition' feature to the idlelib IDE

context.learner_level: mostly third- and fourth-year computer science students

assessment.summary: Add context-menu navigation from a method use to its definition in idlelib.
student_actions: Use Copilot chat, explanation, fix, test, documentation, or generation features.
Document feature use and submit the chat transcript.

outputs.artifact: idlelib code changes, process journal, and Copilot transcript

student_role.description: GitHub Copilot use was required and explicitly taught; the process journal had to account for seven Copilot features.

grading.method: Full credit required submission of the process journal and chat transcript; the feature rubric was not reported.

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

reported_results: 48 process journals and 47 chat transcripts were analyzed; 63% attempted a one-shot whole-feature prompt.

evidence_excerpts.quote: add a 'Go to Definition' feature to the idlelib IDE
